name: Crinkled Silk Tiered Festive Dress
description: This exquisite fusion dress features alternating tiers of olive green and vibrant fuchsia in a beautifully crinkled silk fabric that drapes effortlessly. Accentuated with a delicate gold zari border at the waist and hem, this sleeveless silhouette seamlessly blends traditional elegance with contemporary style, making it perfect for festive gatherings and intimate celebrations. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Blush Pink Floral Embroidered Dress
description: Crafted from lightweight, flowing georgette in a dreamy blush pink hue, this ankle-length dress features a flattering square neckline and elegant three-quarter puff sleeves. Delicate hand-embroidered floral borders adorn the bodice, complemented by matching floral motifs along the ruffled hemline for a touch of whimsical charm. Perfect for intimate festive gatherings, daytime celebrations, or elegant soirées, this piece effortlessly blends modern grace with traditional craftsmanship. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Midnight Blue Woven Zari Lehenga
description: Draped in a majestic midnight blue hue, this voluminous flared lehenga features subtle checkered weave accents paired with a rich metallic gold zari woven border at the hemline. Complemented by a tailored elbow-sleeve blouse and a lightweight sheer tulle dupatta trimmed with ornate brocade borders, it stands as a quintessential choice for grand receptions and festive soirées. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Emerald Ivory Tissue Lehenga Set
description: Exuding timeless grace, this ensemble features a delicately woven off-white tissue skirt seamlessly paired with a rich emerald green blouse adorned with intricate gold motifs. The look is complete with a lightweight sheer dupatta trimmed in a regal zari lace border, perfect for intimate wedding ceremonies and festive celebrations. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Teal Zari Kurta and Ivory Skirt
description: This elegant ensemble features a sleeveless short kurta in deep peacock teal, adorned with delicate gold zari butis and finished with a rich crimson border, paired beautifully with a voluminous off-white flared skirt. Perfect for festive celebrations and intimate wedding gatherings, this contemporary take on traditional Kerala aesthetics exudes effortless grace and sophistication. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Royal Teal Flared Georgette Anarkali
description: Draped in rich peacock teal georgette, this floor-length Anarkali ensemble exudes timeless elegance with its sweeping flared silhouette and fitted full sleeves. The look is beautifully complemented by a lightweight sheer dupatta adorned with delicate embroidered silver lace borders, making it an exquisite choice for regal celebrations and evening festivities. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Royal Blue Pearl Embellished Sharara Set
description: Rendered in an opulent royal blue georgette fabric, this breathtaking ensemble features a short tunic delicately detailed with pearl work along the square neckline and scalloped hemline. Paired with a gracefully voluminous flared bottom and a translucent dupatta bordered in pearls, it creates a silhouette of captivating elegance. Ideal for festive soirees, sangeet celebrations, and grand evening receptions. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Teal Wave Print Jacket Ensemble
description: Exquisitely tailored in vibrant ocean-teal tones, this modern two-piece ensemble features a sleek inner dress layered under a mandarin-collared jacket adorned with rhythmic chevron wave patterns. Designed with seamless side pockets and effortless drape, it is an ideal choice for boutique gatherings, festive lunches, and contemporary soirées. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Midnight Blue Shimmer Anarkali Gown
description: Crafted in deep navy georgette woven with luminous metallic zari pinstripes, this sleeveless Anarkali gown embodies effortless modern grace. The structured V-neckline is highlighted with delicate hand-stitched detailing, cascading gracefully into a voluminous, fluid silhouette ideal for evening celebrations and festive gatherings. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Crimson Gold Embellished Bridal Lehenga
description: Exuding regal splendor, this opulent bridal ensemble features a richly detailed crimson blouse adorned with intricate zardozi hand embroidery and sheer embellished sleeves, paired with a shimmering woven gold lehenga skirt. Completed with a luxurious tissue dupatta, it is meticulously tailored for grand wedding receptions and evening celebrations. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Royal Blue Brocade Halter Blouse
description: Impeccably tailored from lustrous royal blue silk brocade, this high-neck halter blouse features intricate woven gold zari floral motifs that radiate contemporary charm. Perfectly paired with ivory kasavu drapes or festive lehengas, it offers a striking silhouette ideal for evening celebrations and wedding receptions. Note: No Return Policy.

name: Ivory Kasavu Striped Kurta Mundu Set
description:
Imbued with understated elegance, this pristine off-white kurta features delicate vertical gold kasavu zari stripes for a refined festive charm. Paired impeccably with a traditional golden zari-bordered mundu, this ensemble honors Kerala's rich sartorial heritage with contemporary elegance. Perfect for Onam celebrations, traditional wedding ceremonies, and auspicious festive rituals.

name: Ivory Floral Hand-Painted Kasavu Saree
description:
This exquisite ivory Kasavu saree celebrates Kerala's rich heritage, beautifully adorned with delicate, hand-painted floral motifs in soft pink and leafy green hues. Crafted from premium handloom cotton, it features a classic golden zari border paired with a matching puff-sleeved blouse that exudes vintage grace. Perfect for Onam festivities, temple visits, or intimate wedding celebrations, this drape is a timeless ode to traditional elegance.

Note: No Return Policy.

name: Ivory Kasavu Embroidered Corset Gown
description:
Reimagining traditional Kerala heritage with modern allure, this ivory gown features a structured strapless corset bodice delicately detailed with hand-embroidered golden motifs. Highlighted by classic golden Kasavu zari borders running down the fitted silhouette, it effortlessly blends regal grace with contemporary elegance. Perfectly suited for grand wedding receptions, engagement ceremonies, and opulent festive celebrations.

name: Scarlet Embroidered Organza Fusion Set

The lightweight jacket is beautifully elevated by delicate scalloped gold zari embroidery tracing the borders and cuffs, adding a touch of traditional craftsmanship to a modern silhouette. Perfect for festive soirées, pre-wedding celebrations, or evening receptions, this ensemble effortlessly balances modern sophistication with timeless grace.
